dedupe_keys.name: finite element models of masonry lap splice tests with grade 60 and grade 80 rebars

description: Finite element models of masonry lap-splice tests with Grade 60 and Grade 80 rebars is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Dimitrios Kalliontzis, University of Houston (uh.edu). This DesignSafe publication reports three-dimensional finite element model files used for simulating concrete block and clay brick masonry lap-splice tests with Grade 60 and Grade 80 deformed rebars associated with ASCE Structural Engineering Journal Paper entitled “Evaluating Lap-Splice Length Requirements for Grade 80 Deformed Bars in Structural Masonry”. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: lap splice, development length, bond model, masonry, Grade 80, High Strength Steel. Published 2024-09-12. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
